scientific_integrity: All-size proof uses spectral subspace decomposition. Finite numerical tests provide independent reproducibility checks but not an independent proof or outside audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform real positive first- and second-neighbor hoppings, even ring size at least six, one site-local irreversible absorber, and a localized antipodal initial state; infinite-time capture only. Resonance is not robust to parameter detuning. Literature priority is conditional on examined sources and may be affected by unindexed equivalent work.
title: The first antipodal trapping resonance of two-range quantum rings
